meta.lora_mode: strict unmerged: y = bf16(acc32(W x) + sum_k B[:,k] bf16(acc32(A x))[k])
meta.logprob_path: strict O7: fp32 vocab-tile logits, softcap, 8-tile fixed tree

backend_ids.collective: torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor over the TP device group (NCCL; pure data movement, bit-exact) + local canonical tree; repo DeterministicCollective unavailable: RuntimeError: the RL-Kernel CUDA extension is required; rebuild with `pip install --no-build-isolation -e .`

kv_ownership.attention: full 32/2-head attention run redundantly on every rank after an exact all-gather of q/k/v/gate (bit-identical to TP1)

workers.sampling: token selection uses vLLM's native bf16 soft-capped logits (cuBLAS lm_head); only the selected-token logprob values are recomputed strictly; selected_token_ranks and extra top-k logprob columns stay native
notes: TP>1: vLLM Attention layers built with the full 32/2 heads (KV replicated)
